## 單一元件覆寫

單一元件也可直接用 prop 覆寫，例如 `<ShuoFile placeholder="..." />`、`<ShuoListCard title="..." empty="..." />`，優先於模組設定，也不隨語系改變。

<note>

`messages`、`locales` 只放文案。下拉選單的顯示格式（`format`）、尺寸、每頁筆數等非文案的全站設定，請寫在 [`components`](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults)。開發期間在主控台顯示的警告訊息固定為繁體中文。

</note>


# 模組選項

> 在 nuxt.config.ts 以 shuoUi 設定元件庫。

## 用法

在 `nuxt.config.ts` 以 `shuoUi` 設定，以下為預設值：

```ts [nuxt.config.ts]
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['@nuxt/ui', '@shuo/ui'],
  shuoUi: {
    prefix: 'Shuo',
    theme: true,
    css: true,
    locale: 'zh-TW',
    messages: {},
    locales: {},
    components: {}
  }
});
```

## 選項

<field-group>
<field default="Shuo" name="prefix" type="string">

元件名稱前綴。改為 `My` 後使用 `<MyInputText>`。

</field>

<field default="true" name="theme" type="boolean">

是否套用內建 Nuxt UI 主題，見[樣式與主題](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/theming#%E5%85%A7%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%BB%E9%A1%8C)。`false` 表示完全交給專案決定。

</field>

<field default="true" name="css" type="boolean">

是否載入預設 CSS 變數（`--ui-form-*`），見[表單色票](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/theming#%E8%A1%A8%E5%96%AE%E8%89%B2%E7%A5%A8)。`false` 表示由專案自行定義。

</field>

<field default="zh-TW" name="locale" type="string">

預設語系，頁面沒有設定 Nuxt UI 語系（`<UApp :locale>`）時使用；內建 `zh-TW`、`en`，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages)。

</field>

<field default="{}" name="messages" type="object">

覆寫預設語系的文案，只需寫要修改的項目，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages#%E8%A6%86%E5%AF%AB%E6%96%87%E6%A1%88)。

</field>

<field default="{}" name="locales" type="object">

依語系代碼覆寫文案，也可加入內建以外的語系，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages#%E8%A6%86%E5%AF%AB%E6%96%87%E6%A1%88)。

</field>

<field default="{}" name="components" type="object">

元件全站預設值，依元件分區設定，見[元件全站預設值](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults)。

</field>
</field-group>


# 樣式與主題

> 顏色、表單色票、內建主題，以及單一元件的 ui 覆寫規則。

## 顏色來自你的專案

元件只使用 Nuxt UI 的語意色（`primary`、`neutral`、`error` 等）與 CSS 變數，不寫死顏色。在專案的 `app.config.ts` 設定主題色即可：

```ts [app.config.ts]
export default defineAppConfig({
  ui: { colors: { primary: 'blue', neutral: 'slate' } }
});
```

### 在文件網站預覽主題

標題列右上角的調色盤按鈕可以即時切換主題，整個網站與頁面上的元件範例都會跟著變，用法同 Nuxt UI 官方文件的主題選單：

- **主題組**：一次套用主色、中性色、字型、圖示與圓角，之後可再個別調整；和主題組不同的項目以主色標示。
- **主色、中性色、字型、圖示、圓角**：同 Nuxt UI 的設定。
- **元件尺寸、日期**：Shuo UI 的全站元件預設值，一次切換所有輸入元件的 `size` 與日期選擇器的民國／西元年；切換圖示集時，元件自己的圖示（日曆、清除、下載等）也會換成同一套。
- **元件語系**：切換元件範例的語系（繁體中文或英文），預設跟隨文件語言，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages)。
- **明暗模式**：淺色、深色或跟隨系統。
- **匯出設定**：產生目前設定對應的 `app.config.ts`、CSS 與 `nuxt.config.ts`，只列出和預設不同的項目，可直接複製到專案。

設定只存在目前的瀏覽器，不影響其他人。範例上明確傳入的參數（例如指定 `calendar-icon` 或 `:roc="false"`）優先於這裡的設定。

## 表單色票

輸入框邊框與停用狀態的顏色由下列 CSS 變數決定，淺色與深色模式各有一組。停用色使用 Nuxt UI 的中性色，色調會跟著 `app.config.ts` 的 `ui.colors.neutral`；邊框使用主色，深色模式改用較亮的色階：

```css
:root {
  --ui-form-border: var(--ui-color-primary-700); /* 輸入框邊框 */
  --ui-form-disabled-text: var(--ui-color-neutral-600); /* 停用文字 */
  --ui-form-disabled-border: var(--ui-color-neutral-400); /* 停用邊框 */
  --ui-form-disabled-bg: var(--ui-color-neutral-100); /* 停用背景 */
}

.dark {
  --ui-form-border: var(--ui-color-primary-400);
  --ui-form-disabled-text: var(--ui-color-neutral-400);
  --ui-form-disabled-border: var(--ui-color-neutral-600);
  --ui-form-disabled-bg: var(--ui-color-neutral-800);
}
```

要全站改色時，在專案的 CSS 重新定義即可，模組載入的預設值權重最低，不需要 `!important`。只寫 `:root` 時淺色與深色模式都套用同一個值；兩種模式要用不同顏色時，再加上 `.dark`（寫在 `:root` 之後）：

```css [app/assets/css/main.css]
:root {
  --ui-form-disabled-bg: var(--ui-color-neutral-50);
}

.dark {
  --ui-form-disabled-bg: var(--ui-color-neutral-900);
}
```

## 內建主題

`theme: true` 時，模組以 `defu` 把下列 Nuxt UI 主題當作**預設值**加入 `appConfig.ui`；專案 `app.config.ts` 的 `ui` 設定優先。

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      元件
    </th>
    
    <th>
      內容
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        input
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        textarea
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        select
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        selectMenu
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      邊框使用 <code>
        --ui-form-border
      </code>
      
      ，停用時使用停用色票
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        checkbox
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        radioGroup
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      停用時保留勾選狀態，文字可換行
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        formField
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      預設尺寸 <code>
        lg
      </code>
      
      、標題單行省略、錯誤訊息嵌在下邊線
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

想改其中一項，在 `app.config.ts` 覆寫即可：

```ts [app.config.ts]
export default defineAppConfig({
  ui: {
    formField: {
      slots: { error: 'text-xs text-error' } // 改成一般樣式的錯誤訊息
    }
  }
});
```

<tip>

完全不要內建主題：設定 `shuoUi: { theme: false }`，再自行設定 `ui.input`、`ui.formField` 等。

</tip>

## 單一元件的 `ui` prop

元件的 `ui` 寫法同 Nuxt UI 的 `ui` slots，只影響該元件；要改全站所有 Nuxt UI 元件，請用上一節的 `app.config.ts`。

### 合併規則

- 元件內建樣式在前、傳入的 `ui` 在後，以 tailwind-merge 合併，同一 slot 衝突時以傳入值優先。例如 `ShuoInputNumber` 內建 `base: 'text-right'`，傳入 `{ base: 'text-center' }` 後改為置中，其他內建樣式保留。
- 傳入函式 `(defaults) => string` 時，`defaults` 已包含內建樣式，回傳值即為最終樣式，可完整取代：

```vue
<ShuoInputNumber
  :ui="{
    base: (defaults) => defaults.replace('text-right', 'text-left')
  }"
/>
```

### `class` 落在哪裡

傳入的 `class` 落在元件外框，與 `ui.root` 一起合併且排在後面，可覆寫內建寬度（例如 `class="w-14"`）。以下元件例外：

# v1.0.1

> 發佈於 2026年10月25日

> `1.0.0` 在未安裝 `@iconify-json/lucide` 的專案中無法建置，已撤回，請直接使用 `1.0.1`。本版內容即第一個正式版本，並包含下方的修正。

Shuo UI 第一個正式版本：依照我們專案的表單寫法整理出來的 [Nuxt UI](https://ui.nuxt.com) 元件，以 Nuxt Module 提供，共 15 個元件。完整說明與可操作的範例見[文件網站](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/)。

## ✨ Highlights

### 🧩 建立在 Nuxt UI 之上

元件包裝 Nuxt UI，沒有另外宣告的 Nuxt UI 參數、slot 與 ref 都能直接使用，型別也會一併推導，照 Nuxt UI 文件使用即可：[沿用 Nuxt UI](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#%E6%B2%BF%E7%94%A8-nuxt-ui)

```vue
<ShuoInputText v-model="keyword" variant="soft" icon="i-lucide-search" />
```

### 🇹🇼 繁體中文與台灣常用格式

文案預設繁體中文，並內建專案中常見的格式：身分證字號遮蔽、金額千分位、民國年日期、區碼與電話、年月數換算。綁定值維持原始資料（西元日期、純數字），只在顯示時轉換。

```vue
<ShuoInputText v-model="idNumber" :mask="4" />
<ShuoInputNumber v-model="amount" unit />
<!-- 顯示 115/10/25，綁定值為 2026/10/25 -->
<ShuoDatepicker v-model="applyDate" />
```

### 📐 一致的尺寸與狀態

所有表單輸入元件共用 `size`、`disabled`、`loading`、`skeleton`、`id`、`name`，同尺寸的元件高度一致，並會跟著 `UFormField` 與 `UForm` 的尺寸、停用與錯誤狀態走：[共用參數](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common)

```vue
<UForm :schema="schema" :state="state" :disabled="saving">
  <UFormField label="金額" name="amount" size="md">
    <ShuoInputNumber v-model="state.amount" :skeleton="loading" />
  </UFormField>
</UForm>
```

### ⚙️ 全站預設值與共用驗證規則

尺寸、顯示格式、圖示等可在 `nuxt.config.ts` 統一設定，元件上明確傳入的值仍然優先；常用的 Valibot 驗證規則已自動匯入，錯誤訊息格式全站一致：[元件全站預設值](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults)、[表單驗證](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/form/validation)

```ts
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['@nuxt/ui', '@shuo/ui'],
  shuoUi: {
    components: {
      selectMenu: { format: '{value}_{label}' },
      listCard: { pageSize: 20 }
    }
  }
});
```

```ts
const schema = v.object({
  name: requiredText('姓名'),
  amount: requiredNumber('金額')
});
```

### 🔎 查詢頁版面

`ShuoQueryCard` 放查詢條件、`ShuoListCard` 放查詢結果與後端分頁，查詢中的骨架、空資料與高度過渡都已處理：[查詢條件卡片](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/query-card)、[清單卡片](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/list-card)

## 🚀 新增元件

- **InputText:** 單行文字輸入，可遮蔽全部或最後幾碼（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/text/input-text)）
- **InputNumber:** 數字輸入，離開輸入框後顯示千分位，可指定小數位數與單位（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/text/input-number)）
- **Textarea:** 多行文字輸入，保留換行，可自動調整高度（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/text/textarea)）
- **SelectMenu:** 下拉選單，可搜尋、多選，文字過長時顯示完整提示（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/select-menu)）
- **Datepicker:** 日期選擇器，預設民國年，支援五種精度與範圍選擇（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/date/datepicker)）
- **Checkbox:** 單一核取方塊，可自訂勾選值，文字旁可放附加內容（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox)）
- **RadioGroup:** 單選群組，依視窗寬度自動排列，支援自訂選項欄位與附加內容（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/radio-group)）
- **CheckboxGroup:** 複選群組，依視窗寬度自動排列，支援自訂選項欄位與附加內容（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox-group)）
- **File:** 單檔選擇與既有附件下載，選檔不會自動上傳（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/phone-file/file)）
- **Months:** 年月數換算輸入，可同時綁定總月數、年數與月數（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/date/months)）
- **Phone:** 市話號碼，兩個輸入框分別輸入區碼與電話（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/phone-file/phone)）
- **QueryCard:** 可收合的查詢條件卡片，內含 UForm，欄位以響應式格線排列（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/query-card)）
- **ListCard:** 查詢結果清單卡片，包含標題列、表格與後端分頁（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/list-card)）
- **Table:** 基於 UTable 的純表格，含骨架、空資料與高度過渡（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/table)）
- **InfoTooltip:** 資訊圖示加提示，滑鼠移入或鍵盤聚焦即顯示（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/info-tooltip)）

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **module:** 只把已安裝圖示集的圖示加入 `@nuxt/icon` 的 client bundle。`1.0.0` 固定加入內建的 lucide 圖示，專案沒有安裝 `@iconify-json/lucide` 時，`nuxt build`、`nuxt generate` 會因無法產生 client bundle 而失敗；現在沒有安裝也能建置，圖示改由 `@nuxt/icon` 在執行時載入。建議一併安裝 `@iconify-json/lucide`，讓圖示直接打包進網站。

## ⚠️ 使用前須知

- 核取方塊與選項群組（`ShuoCheckbox`、`ShuoRadioGroup`、`ShuoCheckboxGroup`）的高度與輸入框對齊，因此不支援 Nuxt UI 的說明文字（`description`、`descriptionKey`）、`variant`（card、table）、`indicator` 與 `highlight`，傳入時型別會報錯，執行時也不會套用。
- `ShuoInputNumber` 不提供原生 `min`、`max`、`step`，數值範圍請用驗證規則。
- 選檔不會自動上傳：`ShuoFile` 只負責選擇與下載，上傳時機由頁面決定。

## 📦 安裝

```bash
pnpm add github:k90325248/shuo-ui#v1.0.1
pnpm add @iconify-json/lucide # 建議，圖示會直接打包
```

在 `nuxt.config.ts` 啟用模組，並在 CSS 加上 `@import '@shuo/ui/css';`，步驟見文件網站的[安裝](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/overview/installation)。

# v1.1.0

> 發佈於 2026年10月26日

新增 `ShuoTooltip`，手機上長按即可查看所有提示；元件文案改為跟隨 Nuxt UI 的語系，內建繁體中文與英文。文件網站同步推出英文版，並重新整理成分頁與分組。升級前請先看下方的「升級須知」：自動匯入的函式範圍與元件文案的語系行為有調整。

## ✨ Highlights

### 📱 手機上長按查看提示

Nuxt UI 的 `UTooltip` 只在滑鼠移入或鍵盤聚焦時顯示，手機上點擊、按住都不會出現。新的 `ShuoTooltip` 沿用 `UTooltip` 的全部參數與 slot，補上觸控裝置的長按顯示；`ShuoInfoTooltip` 與下拉選單、日期選擇器、檔案選擇、核取方塊、選項群組的文字截斷提示都改用它，在手機上一樣長按顯示：[Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip)

```vue
<ShuoTooltip text="儲存草稿">
  <UButton label="儲存" />
</ShuoTooltip>
```

長按顯示提示時不會觸發原本的點擊、勾選或開啟選單。要恢復 Nuxt UI 原本的行為，單一元件傳 `:touch="false"`，或在全站設定 `components.tooltip.touch: false`。

### 🌐 元件文案跟隨 Nuxt UI 語系

驗證訊息、無障礙名稱、提示文字、日期選擇器的月份與星期等文案，跟著 `<UApp :locale>` 切換，內建繁體中文與英文，已顯示的元件會立即更新。文案可依語系覆寫，也可以加入內建以外的語系：[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages)

```ts
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  shuoUi: {
    locale: 'zh-TW', // 頁面沒有設定 UApp 語系時使用
    locales: {
      en: { listCard: { title: 'Search results' } }
    }
  }
});
```

### 🌙 深色模式的表單色票

停用中的輸入框在深色模式改用較暗的底色與較亮的文字，不再沿用淺色模式的顏色；輸入框邊框在深色模式改用較亮的主色。停用色也從固定的灰色改為 Nuxt UI 的中性色，色調跟著專案 `app.config.ts` 的 `ui.colors.neutral`。顏色由 `--ui-form-*` 變數決定，可在專案 CSS 以 `:root` 與 `.dark` 分別覆寫：[表單色票](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/theming#%E8%A1%A8%E5%96%AE%E8%89%B2%E7%A5%A8)

## 🚀 新增元件

- **Tooltip:** 基於 UTooltip 的提示，補上觸控裝置長按顯示（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip)）

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **InputText:** 遮蔽的文字切換為明碼時，不再先閃一下所有文字。
- **Months:** 「年」「月」單位的寬度依文字調整，英文的 `yr`、`mo` 不會被截斷。

## ⚠️ 升級須知

### 只自動匯入公開的工具函式

先前模組會自動匯入 `runtime/utils` 與 `runtime/composables` 底下的所有函式，元件內部使用的工具也一併暴露給專案。現在只自動匯入下列公開函式，參數與範例見文件網站新的[工具函式](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/utils/form/validation)分頁：

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      分類
    </th>
    
    <th>
      函式
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      驗證規則
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        requiredText
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        requiredNumber
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        requiredArray
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        optionalEmail
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        optionalNonNegativeNumber
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      顯示格式
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        formatDateDisplay
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        parseDateValue
      </code>
      
      、<code>
        formatNumberDisplay
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>

      欄位拆合
    </td>

      </code>

`getShuoMessages`、`setShuoMessages`、`formatMessage`、`toNumberText`、`getDecimalPlaces`、`filterPhoneInput`、`getDateModelFormat`、`isValidDateSeparator`、`useChoiceGroup`、`useTruncatedText` 等內部函式不再自動匯入。專案有用到時，建置會出現找不到函式的錯誤；這些函式不屬於公開 API，之後可能調整，建議改用上表的公開函式或模組選項（例如文案改用 `shuoUi.messages`、`shuoUi.locales` 覆寫）。

### 元件文案跟隨 UApp 的語系

先前元件文案固定為繁體中文。現在元件會跟隨 `<UApp :locale>`：

- 沒有設定 `UApp` 的 `locale`，或設定為繁體中文時，畫面和先前相同。
- 設定了其他語系（例如英文）的專案，升級後元件文案會跟著變成該語系。需要調整文字時，以 `shuoUi.locales` 依語系覆寫，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages#%E8%A6%86%E5%AF%AB%E6%96%87%E6%A1%88)。

## 📖 文件網站

- **英文版：** 右上角可切換繁體中文與英文，網址改為 `/zh-tw/...` 與 `/en/...`，根網址依上次選擇的語言導向。1.0.1 的頁面網址已不再使用，請從[首頁](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/)重新進入。
- **分頁與分組：** 內容分成「開始使用」「元件」「工具函式」三個分頁，左側選單依用途分組。
- **主題選單：** 右上角的調色盤可即時切換主題色、字型、圓角、元件尺寸、民國／西元年與元件語系，並匯出對應的 `app.config.ts`、CSS 與 `nuxt.config.ts`。

## 📦 安裝

```bash

```

在 `nuxt.config.ts` 啟用模組，並在 CSS 加上 `@import '@shuo/ui/css';`，步驟見文件網站的[安裝](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/overview/installation)。

# v1.2.0

> 發佈於 2026年10月27日

新增 `ShuoSwitch`，切換後可以先呼叫 API，成功才更新、失敗自動復原；表格與清單卡片支援勾選；核取方塊、選項群組與開關支援說明文字。文件網站的元件更新紀錄改為依語系顯示。升級前請先看下方的「升級須知」：選項資料原本就帶有 `description` 欄位的群組，升級後會顯示說明。

## ✨ Highlights

### 🔀 切換後先處理、成功才更新的開關

新的 `ShuoSwitch` 沿用 `USwitch` 的參數，多了 `action`：切換後先顯示新的值並進入載入中、停用，處理函式回傳 `false` 或丟出錯誤時自動復原，其他回傳值才更新 `v-model` 並送出 `change`。適合切換當下就要呼叫 API 儲存的設定：[Switch](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/switch)

```vue
<ShuoSwitch v-model="enabled" label="啟用帳號" :action="(value) => api.setEnabled(value)" />
```

高度與同尺寸的輸入框一致，文字過長時省略並以 Tooltip 顯示完整文字，與核取方塊相同；`size`、`color`、`loadingIcon` 可在全站設定 `components.switch`。按鈕不需要另外包裝，`UButton` 的 `loading-auto` 已提供相同的處理中狀態。

### ☑️ 表格與清單卡片勾選

`ShuoTable` 與 `ShuoListCard` 加上 `selectable` 後，在最前面加上勾選欄，勾選結果以 `v-model:selected` 綁定 key 陣列：[Table 的勾選](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/table#%E5%8B%BE%E9%81%B8)

```vue
<ShuoListCard
  v-model:selected="selected"
  :data="rows"
  :columns="columns"
  selectable
  row-key="ID"
  :row-selectable="(row) => row.status !== '已結案'"
  @page-change="search"
/>
```

- `row-key` 為欄位名稱或函式；後端分頁時換頁仍保留其他頁的勾選，可以一次處理多頁勾選的資料。
- 表頭的全選只勾選目前這頁可勾選的資料，部分勾選時顯示半選；`select-all` 設為 `false` 時改顯示 `selection-header` 的文字。
- `row-selectable` 回傳 `false` 的資料停用勾選；查詢中停用所有核取方塊。
- `checkbox-props` 設定核取方塊的 `class`、`ui`、`color`、`size` 與圖示；`columns` 中放 `{ id: 'select' }` 可指定勾選欄的位置，`#select-header`、`#select-cell` 插槽可完全自訂。
- `selectAll`、`checkboxProps` 可在全站設定 `components.table`。

沒有開啟 `selectable` 時行為不變，先前以 `tableProps` 自行控制勾選的寫法照常可用。

### 📝 核取方塊、選項群組與開關的說明文字

`ShuoCheckbox`、`ShuoRadioGroup`、`ShuoCheckboxGroup` 與 `ShuoSwitch` 支援說明文字（群組以選項的 `description` 欄位或 `description-key` 指定）。沒有說明時高度仍與輸入框一致；有說明時往下撐高、說明換行，第一行文字仍與旁邊的欄位對齊。水平排列的群組整列一起撐高，說明不會擠壓其他選項的文字：[Checkbox 的說明文字](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox#%E8%AA%AA%E6%98%8E%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97)

```vue
<ShuoCheckbox v-model="subscribe" label="訂閱電子報" description="每週寄送一次最新公告，可以隨時取消" />
```

## 🚀 新增元件

- **Switch:** 開關，切換後可先執行處理函式，成功才更新綁定值，失敗或丟出錯誤時自動復原（[文件](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/switch)）

## ⚠️ 升級須知

### 選項資料的 description 欄位會顯示

先前單選與複選群組不顯示選項說明，選項資料就算帶有 `description` 欄位也會被忽略。現在會顯示在選項文字下方，並讓選項撐高。

選項直接使用後端資料、而資料剛好有 `description` 欄位（例如代碼表的備註）時，升級後畫面會多出說明。不想顯示時，在傳入前移除該欄位：

```ts
const options = computed(() => codes.value.map(({ description: _description, ...item }) => item));
```

## 📖 文件網站

- **版本紀錄：** 標題列新增「版本紀錄」分頁，可查看每個版本的發佈說明，與 GitHub Release 內容相同，英文版顯示英文說明。
- **更新紀錄依語系顯示：** 元件頁最後的更新紀錄改為依文件語系顯示中文或英文說明，不再顯示 `feat:`、`fix:` 等前綴。
- **新頁面：** 新增 [Switch](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/switch)；Table、ListCard、Checkbox、RadioGroup、CheckboxGroup 頁新增勾選與說明文字的用法與範例；共用參數頁的範例加入開關。

## 📦 安裝

```bash
pnpm add github:k90325248/shuo-ui#v1.2.0
pnpm add @iconify-json/lucide # 建議，圖示會直接打包
```

在 `nuxt.config.ts` 啟用模組，並在 CSS 加上 `@import '@shuo/ui/css';`，步驟見文件網站的[安裝](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/overview/installation)。

# Months

> 總月數與年、月的拆分與合併。

## 用法

[Months](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/date/months) 以總月數綁定，另可綁定 `year` 與 `month`。清單顯示或後端分開存年、月時，用這兩個函式轉換：

```vue
<template>
  <ShuoListCard :data="rows" :columns="columns">
    <!-- 貸款期間 -->
    <template #terms-cell="{ row }">
      {{ toYearMonth(row.original.terms) }}
    </template>
  </ShuoListCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// 總月數轉成「2 年 6 個月」；空值顯示空字串。
const toYearMonth = (terms: number | null) => {
  const months = splitMonths(terms);
  return months ? `${months.year} 年 ${months.month} 個月` : '';
};
</script>
```

函式由模組自動匯入。兩個函式都回傳同一種結果：

```ts
interface MonthsValue {
  total: number; // 總月數
  year: number; // 完整年數
  month: number; // 剩餘月數，0 至 11
}
```

## API

### splitMonths

```ts
splitMonths(value: unknown): MonthsValue | null
```

把總月數拆成年與月。只接受非負的安全整數，空值、負數、小數與非數字回傳 `null`。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="value" type="unknown">

總月數。

</field>
</field-group>

### combineMonths

```ts
combineMonths(
  year: number | null | undefined,
  month: number | null | undefined
): MonthsValue | null
```

合併年與月並處理進位，例如 1 年 14 個月為 2 年 2 個月。單邊為空時視為 `0`，兩邊都為空時回傳 `null`；負數或非整數回傳 `null`。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="year" type="number | null | undefined">

年數。

</field>

<field :required="true" name="month" type="number | null | undefined">

月數，可超過 11。

</field>
</field-group>

## 範例

```ts
splitMonths(30); // { total: 30, year: 2, month: 6 }
splitMonths(null); // null
splitMonths(1.5); // null

combineMonths(2, 6); // { total: 30, year: 2, month: 6 }
combineMonths(1, 14); // { total: 26, year: 2, month: 2 }
combineMonths(null, 8); // { total: 8, year: 0, month: 8 }
combineMonths(null, null); // null
```


# Phone

> 市話號碼的區碼拆分與合併。

## 用法

[Phone](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/phone-file/phone) 以 `v-model` 綁定完整號碼，另可綁定 `area-code` 與 `number`。後端分開存區碼與號碼、或要在畫面上分開顯示時，用這兩個函式轉換：

```ts
// 後端回傳完整號碼與區碼，拆成兩欄
const { areaCode, number } = splitPhone(data.phone, data.areaCode);

// 送出前合併
const phone = joinPhone(state.areaCode, state.number);
```

函式由模組自動匯入。號碼只包含數字，不加入 `-` 或括號等分隔符號。

## API

### splitPhone

```ts
splitPhone(
  value: string | undefined,
  areaCode: string | undefined
): { areaCode: string | undefined; number: string | undefined }
```

依已知的區碼拆分完整號碼。台灣區碼長度不固定，無法確定區碼時不猜測長度：區碼為空或號碼不是以該區碼開頭時，區碼回傳空字串，完整號碼放在 `number`。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="value" type="string | undefined">

完整號碼。`undefined` 或空字串時，區碼與號碼都回傳相同的值。

</field>

<field :required="true" name="areaCode" type="string | undefined">

已知的區碼，例如 `02`。

</field>
</field-group>

### joinPhone

```ts
joinPhone(
  areaCode: string | undefined,
  number: string | undefined
): string | undefined
```

合併區碼與號碼，不加入分隔符號。兩者都是 `undefined` 時回傳 `undefined`（表示尚未初始化），其中一邊為 `undefined` 時視為空字串。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="areaCode" type="string | undefined">

區碼。

</field>

<field :required="true" name="number" type="string | undefined">

電話號碼。

</field>
</field-group>

## 範例

```ts
splitPhone('0223456789', '02'); // { areaCode: '02', number: '23456789' }
splitPhone('0223456789', '03'); // { areaCode: '', number: '0223456789' }
splitPhone('0223456789', undefined); // { areaCode: '', number: '0223456789' }

joinPhone('02', '23456789'); // '0223456789'
joinPhone(undefined, undefined); // undefined
```


# Validation

> 搭配 Valibot 的共用驗證規則，錯誤訊息格式全站一致。

## 用法

規則由模組自動匯入，回傳 Valibot schema，直接放進 `v.object` 組合表單的 schema：

```ts
import * as v from 'valibot';

const schema = v.object({
  name: requiredText('姓名'),
  amount: requiredNumber('金額'),
  types: requiredArray('類別', v.string())
});
```

- 參數 `label` 是畫面上的欄位名稱，預設錯誤訊息為「欄位名稱 說明」，例如「姓名 為必填」。訊息跟隨 Nuxt UI 的語系，在驗證當下才產生，切換語系後重新驗證即為新語系；可用模組設定 `shuoUi.messages.validation` 或 `shuoUi.locales` 覆寫，見[多語系與文案](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages)。
- 輸入型別容納編輯中的 `null`、`undefined`，驗證通過後的輸出收斂為 `string`、`number` 或陣列，不需要改掉元件的空值約定。
- 表單、空值與錯誤顯示的整體說明見[表單驗證](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/form/validation)。

<note>

專案裡 `import * as v from 'valibot'` 時，請另外安裝 `valibot`（`pnpm add valibot`），pnpm 不會讓專案直接引用套件的依賴。

</note>

## API

### requiredText

```ts
requiredText(label: string)
```

文字必填。拒絕 `null`、`undefined`、空字串、純空白與非字串值，保留原始文字（不去除前後空白）。適用文字輸入、多行文字、下拉選單與單選群組的字串值、日期字串。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="label" type="string">

欄位名稱，用於錯誤訊息。

</field>
</field-group>

### requiredNumber

```ts
requiredNumber(label: string)
```

數字必填。接受 `0`、負數與小數；空值與字串顯示「為必填」，`NaN` 與無限大顯示「必須是有效數字」。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="label" type="string">

欄位名稱，用於錯誤訊息。

</field>
</field-group>

### requiredArray

```ts
requiredArray(label: string, itemSchema: GenericSchema)
```

陣列必填，至少一項。空陣列、`null` 與 `undefined` 不通過。適用複選群組與多選下拉選單。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="label" type="string">

欄位名稱，用於錯誤訊息。

</field>

<field :required="true" name="itemSchema" type="GenericSchema">

每個項目的 schema，例如 `v.string()`；選項的合法值由頁面自行組合，不寫死在共用規則。

</field>
</field-group>

### optionalEmail

```ts
optionalEmail(label: string)
```

選填電子信箱。空字串通過；有值時須符合 email 格式，否則顯示「格式錯誤」。必填的信箱改用 `requiredText` 串接 `v.email`。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="label" type="string">

欄位名稱，用於錯誤訊息。

</field>
</field-group>

### optionalNonNegativeNumber

```ts
optionalNonNegativeNumber(label: string)
```

選填非負數字。`null` 通過；接受 `0` 與小數；負數顯示「不可小於 0」，`NaN`、無限大與非數字顯示「必須是有效數字」。適用金額、期數、評分、利率等選填欄位。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="label" type="string">

欄位名稱，用於錯誤訊息。

</field>
</field-group>

## 範例

### 組合其他 Valibot 規則

共用規則都是一般的 Valibot schema，可以再用 `v.pipe` 追加條件：

```ts
import * as v from 'valibot';

const schema = v.object({
  // 必填的信箱：必填規則再串接格式檢查
  email: v.pipe(requiredText('電子郵件'), v.email('電子郵件 格式錯誤')),

  // 選填的整數期數
  terms: v.pipe(
    optionalNonNegativeNumber('期數'),
    v.check(
      (value) => value === null || Number.isInteger(value),
      '期數 須為整數'
    )
  ),

  // 備用信箱可留空
  backupEmail: optionalEmail('備用電子郵件')
});
```

### 搭配表單

完整的表單寫法與即時範例見各元件頁的「搭配表單驗證」，例如 [InputText](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/text/input-text)、[SelectMenu](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/select-menu)。

---

- [Valibot](https://valibot.dev/guides/introduction/)


# Date

> 西元日期字串的民國年顯示與嚴格解析。

## 用法

綁定值與 API 資料一律保留西元，只在顯示時轉成民國年。清單、明細等畫面直接在 template 呼叫：

```vue
<template>
  <ShuoListCard :data="rows" :columns="columns">
    <!-- 申請日期 -->
    <template #applyDate-cell="{ row }">
      {{ formatDateDisplay(row.original.applyDate) }}
    </template>
  </ShuoListCard>
</template>
```

- 函式由模組自動匯入，不用 import。
- 字串日期可用 `/` 或 `-` 分隔，時間以空白接續，月、日、時、分、秒要補足兩位；不接受含 `T`、`Z` 或時區的 ISO 字串，也不做時區轉換。
- 日期選擇器的綁定格式與 `mode` 見 [Datepicker](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/date/datepicker)。

## API

### formatDateDisplay

```ts
formatDateDisplay(
  value: string | Date | null | undefined,
  options?: DateDisplayOptions
): string
```

把西元日期轉成顯示文字，預設為民國年月日。空值、無效日期與不符合精度的字串回傳空字串；民國模式下早於 1911 年的日期也回傳空字串。

<field-group>
<field name="value" type="string | Date | null | undefined" :required="true">

西元日期字串或 `Date`。字串須符合 `mode` 的精度，例如 `mode: 'month'` 時為 `2026/10`。

</field>

<field name="options.mode" type="'year' | 'month' | 'date' | 'datetime' | 'datetime-second'">

日期精度，預設 `date`。

</field>

<field name="options.roc" type="boolean">

是否顯示民國年，預設 `true`；`false` 顯示西元。

</field>

<field name="options.yearMonthLabels" type="boolean | { year: string; month: string }">

年與年月加上單位，預設 `false`。`true` 使用目前語系的格式（繁體中文為「115 年 10 月」，英文為「10/115」）；也可傳入格式，`{year}`、`{month}` 為年份與兩位數月份，例如 `{ year: '{year}年', month: '{year}年{month}月' }`。

</field>
</field-group>

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      mode
    </th>
    
    <th>
      西元字串
    </th>
    
    <th>
      民國顯示
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        year
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        2026
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        115
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        month
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        2026/10
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        115/10
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        date
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        2026/10/15
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        115/10/15
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        datetime
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        2026/10/15 09:08
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        115/10/15 09:08
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        datetime-second
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        2026/10/15 09:08:07
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        115/10/15 09:08:07
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### parseDateValue

```ts
parseDateValue(
  value: string | null | undefined,
  mode: DateMode,
  separator?: string
): Date | null
```

嚴格解析西元日期字串，格式必須完全符合指定精度與分隔符號（補足兩位、日期存在），否則回傳 `null`。適合在送出前確認日期字串是否有效。

<field-group>
<field name="value" type="string | null | undefined" :required="true">

西元日期字串。

</field>

<field name="mode" type="'year' | 'month' | 'date' | 'datetime' | 'datetime-second'" :required="true">

日期精度。

</field>

<field name="separator" type="string">

日期分隔符號，預設 `/`；日期選擇器設定了 `separator` 時傳入相同的值。

</field>
</field-group>

## 範例

### 顯示格式

```ts
formatDateDisplay('2026/10/15'); // 115/10/15
formatDateDisplay('2026-10-15'); // 115/10/15
formatDateDisplay('2026/10/15', { roc: false }); // 2026/10/15
formatDateDisplay('2026', { mode: 'year' }); // 115
formatDateDisplay('2026/10', {
  mode: 'month',
  yearMonthLabels: true
}); // 115 年 10 月
formatDateDisplay('2026/10/15 09:08', { mode: 'datetime' }); // 115/10/15 09:08
formatDateDisplay('2026/02/30'); // ''（日期不存在）
formatDateDisplay(null); // ''
```

### 嚴格解析

```ts
parseDateValue('2026/10/15', 'date'); // Date
parseDateValue('2026/1/5', 'date'); // null（月、日未補兩位）
parseDateValue('2026/02/30', 'date'); // null（日期不存在）
parseDateValue('2026-10-15', 'date', '-'); // Date
```


# Number

> 千分位與固定小數位數的數字顯示。

## 用法

API 資料與綁定值保留數字，只在顯示時格式化。清單欄位直接在 template 呼叫，不另外建立 formatter：

```vue
<template>
  <ShuoListCard :data="rows" :columns="columns">
    <!-- 金額 -->
    <template #amount-cell="{ row }">
      {{ formatNumberDisplay(row.original.amount) }}
    </template>
  </ShuoListCard>
</template>
```

函式由模組自動匯入，與 [InputNumber](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/text/input-number) 離開輸入框後的顯示使用同一套規則。不要將帶逗號或補零的字串寫回資料。

## API

### formatNumberDisplay

```ts
formatNumberDisplay(
  value: number | null | undefined,
  decimal?: boolean | number,
  thousandSeparator?: boolean
): string
```

把數字轉成顯示文字。`null`、`undefined`、`NaN` 與無限大回傳空字串，`0` 正常顯示；很大或很小的數字也會展開成一般寫法，不出現科學記號。

<field-group>
<field name="value" type="number | null | undefined" :required="true">

要顯示的數字。

</field>

<field name="decimal" type="boolean | number">

小數位數，預設 `true`。`true` 保留原本的小數，不補零；`false` 或 `0` 四捨五入為整數；正整數為固定位數，不足補零、超出時捨入，最多 100 位。

</field>

<field name="thousandSeparator" type="boolean">

是否加上千分位，預設 `true`。

</field>
</field-group>

<note>

`ShuoInputNumber` 的 `decimal` 預設為 `false`（只允許整數），和這裡預設保留小數不同。

</note>

## 範例

```ts
formatNumberDisplay(1234567); // 1,234,567
formatNumberDisplay(-1234.5); // -1,234.5
formatNumberDisplay(1234.5, 3); // 1,234.500
formatNumberDisplay(1234.5, 3, false); // 1234.500
formatNumberDisplay(1234.5, false); // 1,235
formatNumberDisplay(0.1 + 0.2, 2); // 0.30
formatNumberDisplay(0); // 0
formatNumberDisplay(null); // ''
```


# ComponentDefaults

> 在頁面取得元件全站預設值的實際生效值與原始設定。

## 用法

元件的全站預設值在 `nuxt.config.ts` 的 `shuoUi.components` 設定，見[元件全站預設值](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults)。頁面需要和元件使用同一個值時（例如送給後端的每頁筆數要和清單一致），用 `resolveShuoDefault` 取得：

```ts
import type { PageRequest } from '#shuo-ui/types/pagination';

// 後端依此值分頁；頁面另外傳 :page-size 時改用頁面自己的值。
const pageSize = resolveShuoDefault('listCard', 'pageSize');
const request = reactive<PageRequest>({ PageNumber: 1, PageSize: pageSize });
```

函式由模組自動匯入。

## API

### resolveShuoDefault

```ts
resolveShuoDefault(name: ShuoComponentName, key: string)
```

回傳元件某個 prop 實際生效的預設值：有全站設定時為設定值，否則為元件內建預設。內建預設為 `undefined` 的項目（例如 `textarea.rows`）沒有設定時回傳 `undefined`。回傳型別依元件與 prop 推導。

<field-group>
<field :required="true" name="name" type="ShuoComponentName">

元件鍵名，同 `shuoUi.components` 的鍵，例如 `listCard`、`selectMenu`。

</field>

<field :required="true" name="key" type="string">

可全站設定的 prop 名稱，例如 `pageSize`；只接受該元件白名單內的項目，見[可設定的項目](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults#%E5%8F%AF%E8%A8%AD%E5%AE%9A%E7%9A%84%E9%A0%85%E7%9B%AE)。

</field>
</field-group>

### getShuoComponentDefaults

```ts
getShuoComponentDefaults(): ShuoComponentDefaults
```

回傳使用端在 `shuoUi.components` 的原始設定，只包含有設定的項目，不含元件內建預設；需要實際生效值時改用 `resolveShuoDefault`。

## 範例

```ts
// nuxt.config.ts 設定了 listCard.pageSize: 20、沒有設定 selectMenu.format
resolveShuoDefault('listCard', 'pageSize'); // 20
resolveShuoDefault('selectMenu', 'format'); // '{label}'（內建預設）

getShuoComponentDefaults(); // { listCard: { pageSize: 20 } }
```

# Checkbox

> Single checkbox with custom checked values and optional content next to the label.

`v-model: string | number | boolean`, required.

## Usage

### Checked values

`true-value` is the bound value when checked, the number `1` by default; `false-value` is the bound value when unchecked, the number `0` by default. Change them when the back end uses `Y` / `N` or booleans; if the whole project uses the same values, set site-wide defaults for `trueValue` and `falseValue`; see [Configurable props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults#configurable-props).

<component-example name="checkbox-values">



</component-example>

- When the bound value is not `true-value`, the checkbox shows unchecked. In the example, changing only `true-value` makes the existing value no longer match, so it shows unchecked.
- A native form submission sends `true-value` instead of the browser's default `on`.

### Label

`label` defaults to "Enable" ("啟用" in Traditional Chinese), switching with the locale, and can be overridden with the `checkbox.label` text; see [Locales and messages](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages).

<component-example name="checkbox-label">



</component-example>

The label shows on one line and is truncated when wider than its container. A tooltip shows the full text on hover or focus, or on long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)); a long press that shows the tooltip does not change the checked state.

### Description

`description` shows below the label. Without a description, the height matches an input of the same size; with one, the checkbox grows and the description wraps, while the first line still lines up with fields next to it that have no description.

<component-example name="checkbox-description">



</component-example>

### Color and icon

Uses the `color` and `icon` (the checked icon) of `UCheckbox`.

<component-example name="checkbox-color">



</component-example>

### Size and states

The frame height matches an input of the same size. While loading, a spinner of the same size replaces the checkbox and it is disabled. See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the behavior shared by all states.

<component-example name="checkbox-states">



</component-example>

## Examples

### Next to an input

Inside a flex container, the wrapper shrinks with the available space and truncates the label. To show the full label, set `ui.wrapper` to `shrink-0`; a label wider than the container is still truncated with a tooltip.

<component-example name="checkbox-inline">



</component-example>

### Input next to the label

Put an input next to the label with `#append`. When the input is focused, call `check()` from the slot props to check the box too, and use `labelId` as the input's `aria-labelledby`. Clicking non-interactive parts of the appended content does not change the checked state; see [Item append content](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox-group#item-append-content) for details.

<component-example name="checkbox-append">



</component-example>

### Must be checked

For fields that must be checked, such as agreeing to terms, use `v.check` to check that the bound value equals `true-value` (not `v.literal`, which would narrow the UForm state type).

<component-example name="checkbox-validation">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoCheckbox">



</component-props>

See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#shared-props) for the behavior of `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `skeleton`, `id` and `name`. The default of `label` can be overridden with the `checkbox.label` text.

Nuxt UI's `variant` (card), `indicator` and `highlight` are not supported, so that a frame does not make the option taller and break the height alignment with inputs; see [Built on Nuxt UI](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#built-on-nuxt-ui) for why.

## Slots

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      Slot
    </th>

      Props
    </th>
    
    <th>
      Description
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        append
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        checked
      </code>
      
      , <code>
        disabled
      </code>
      
      , <code>
        labelId
      </code>
      
      , <code>
        check()
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Content next to the label; see <a href="https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox-group#item-append-content">
        Item append content
      </a>
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

## Styling

`ui` accepts every slot of Nuxt UI `UCheckbox`, merged as described in [Per-component `ui` prop](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/theming#per-component-ui-prop), plus `wrapper`:

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      Slot
    </th>
    
    <th>
      Part
    </th>
    
    <th>
      Built-in styles
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        wrapper
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Outer wrapper that measures truncation, holds the tooltip and positions the loading icon
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        relative inline-flex w-fit max-w-full min-w-0 align-top
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        root
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Checkbox frame (Nuxt UI)
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        w-fit max-w-full min-w-0
      </code>
      
      , with height matching inputs of the same size and centered vertically
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        label
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Label (Nuxt UI)
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        truncate
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>

      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Checkbox (Nuxt UI)
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        opacity-0
      </code>
      
       while loading
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

The height can also be adjusted with `class="[--form-checkbox-height:1.25rem]"`. `class` goes on the checkbox frame and does not affect the wrapper.

## Changelog

- [UCheckbox](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/checkbox)


# CheckboxGroup

> Checkbox group that lays out by viewport width, with custom item fields and appended content.

`v-model: string[]` (required); item `value`s should not be empty strings. When only one can be chosen, use [RadioGroup](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/radio-group) instead.

## Usage

### Items

`items` accepts objects or strings. Object items show `label` and bind `value`, and `disabled` disables a single item (a checked disabled item stays checked); for string items, both `label` and `value` are the string. With nothing checked, the bound value is `[]`.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-items">



</component-example>

### Orientation

`orientation` defaults to `auto`, switching between vertical and horizontal around `breakpoint` (default `md`) by viewport width; `horizontal` and `vertical` fix the direction regardless of the viewport. When an item label is truncated, hovering or keyboard focus shows a tooltip with the full text, or a long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)); a long press that shows the tooltip does not check the item. `orientation`, `breakpoint`, `label-key`, `value-key` and `ui` can have site-wide defaults; see [Configurable props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults#configurable-props).

<component-example name="checkbox-group-orientation">



</component-example>

### Responsive columns

Use `orientation="grid"` and override the Tailwind column and breakpoint classes with `ui.fieldset`. It defaults to one column, and each row is at least as tall as an input of the same size; truncation tooltips and skeleton behavior are kept.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-grid">



</component-example>

The first group is set to one column by default, two from md and four from xl. `breakpoint` is only used for the horizontal / vertical switch of `orientation="auto"`; grid breakpoints are controlled by the classes. `class` sets the outer frame and `ui.fieldset` sets the item container. Use complete static classes so Tailwind can scan them.

### Custom item fields

When the back-end item fields are not `label` and `value` (for example `{ Code, Name }`), set them with `label-key` and `value-key` instead of converting the data first:

<component-example name="checkbox-group-keys">



</component-example>

- **The bound values must be strings**: the `v-model` type stays `string[]`. If the back-end codes are numbers, convert them to strings first, for example `items.map((item) => ({ ...item, Code: String(item.Code) }))`.
- **The original label and value fields are replaced**: the component turns each object item into "the original fields + `label` and `value` resolved by `labelKey` and `valueKey`". If the original data already has `label` and `value` fields, they are replaced by the resolved values.
- The `item` of `#item-append` is the converted object, with both the original fields (`item.Code`, `item.Name`) and `item.label`, `item.value`.
- In development mode, when the first object item lacks the field set by `labelKey` or `valueKey`, the console warns once (with the component and field names); production does not check. `ShuoSelectMenu` has the same check.

### Item descriptions

An item's `description` field (or the field set by `description-key`) shows below its label. Items without a description match the height of an input of the same size; items with one grow and wrap the description. In horizontal layout the whole row grows, the first lines of all items stay aligned, and the description does not squeeze the labels of other items.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-description">



</component-example>

### Color and icon

Uses the `color` and `icon` of `UCheckboxGroup`: `color` changes the checked color, and `icon` is the icon shown when checked; a single item can also set its own with the item's `icon` field.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-color">



</component-example>

### Size and states

In horizontal layout, the height matches an input of the same size; the example puts a `ShuoInputText` of the same size on the right for comparison. While loading, spinners replace the checkboxes and the group is disabled. See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the behavior shared by all states.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-states">



</component-example>

## Examples

### Item append content

When an item needs an input right next to its label (for example "☐ Other <span>

please specify

</span>

"), use the `#item-append` slot. The example checks "Other" when its description input is focused:

<component-example name="checkbox-group-append">



</component-example>

- Clicking the appended content (the input, the unit or empty space) does not change the checked state; to check on focus, bind `@focus="check"`.
- `disabled` already covers a disabled item, a disabled component, loading and a disabled form.
- `labelId` is the id of the item label; set it as the appended input's `aria-labelledby`. The checkbox itself is named only by the item label and does not include the input's value.
- The appended input is not part of the outer `UFormField`. To validate it, wrap it in its own `UFormField`, or show its error together through the outer `error-pattern`.

### With form validation

Use `requiredArray` to require at least one item, with your own item schema (see [Validation](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/form/validation#shared-rules)). In the example, the "Other" description input is wrapped in its own `UFormField`, and the outer `error-pattern` shows its error together; when "Other" is not checked, the input is disabled and not checked.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-validation">



</component-example>

### Select all and clear

Select all and clear rewrite the `v-model` array directly; the example puts the buttons in the `#hint` of `UFormField`, and select all skips disabled items.

<component-example name="checkbox-group-select-all">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoCheckboxGroup">



</component-props>

See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#shared-props) for the behavior of `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `skeleton`, `id` and `name`.

Nuxt UI's `variant` (card, table), `indicator` and `highlight` are not supported, so that a frame does not make the items taller and break the height alignment with inputs; see [Built on Nuxt UI](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#built-on-nuxt-ui) for why.

### Item fields

Items (`CheckboxGroupOption`) use Nuxt UI's item fields, with `value` limited to strings.

## Styling

The built-in styles are written in `ui` and can be overridden directly (see [Per-component `ui` prop](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/theming#per-component-ui-prop)):

<table>

    <th>
      Slot
    </th>

    </th>

      Built-in styles
    </th>

    <td>
      <code>
        root
      </code>
    </td>

    </td>

      </code>
      
      ; <code>
        w-full max-w-full min-w-0
      </code>
      
       for <code>
        grid
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>

    <td>
      <code>
        fieldset
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Item container
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        min-w-0 flex-nowrap justify-start
      </code>
      
      ; horizontal adds <code>
        items-center gap-x-2
      </code>
      
       with height matching inputs of the same size; <code>
        grid
      </code>
      
       adds <code>
        grid grid-cols-1
      </code>
    </td>

      </code>
    </td>

      Single item
    </td>

      <code>
        min-w-0 w-fit max-w-full text-start
      </code>
      
      ; horizontal adds <code>
        items-center
      </code>
      
       and can shrink; <code>
        grid
      </code>
      
       adds <code>
        items-center
      </code>
      
       with a minimum height matching inputs of the same size; <code>
        relative
      </code>
      
       while loading
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        base
      </code>
    </td>

      Checkbox
    </td>

      </code>

    </td>
  </tr>

        wrapper
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Item label wrapper
    </td>

      <code>
        w-auto min-w-0
      </code>
      
      ; <code>
        ms-1
      </code>
      
       in horizontal layout
    </td>
  </tr>

    <td>
      <code>
        label
      </code>
    </td>

      Item label
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        w-fit max-w-full
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

For example, `:ui="{ fieldset: 'gap-x-8' }"` widens the gap between items in horizontal layout. The defaults passed to the function form include the built-in styles above; when replacing `fieldset` in `grid` mode, keep `grid`, for example `(defaults) => defaults.replace('grid-cols-1', 'grid-cols-3')`.

# RadioGroup

> Radio group that lays out by viewport width, with custom item fields and appended content.

`v-model: string`; item `value`s should not be empty strings. For multiple selection, use [CheckboxGroup](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox-group) instead.

## Usage

### Items

`items` accepts objects or strings. Object items show `label` and bind `value`, and `disabled` disables a single item; for string items, both `label` and `value` are the string. With nothing selected, the bound value is `''`.

<component-example name="radio-group-items">



</component-example>

### Orientation

`orientation` defaults to `auto`, switching between vertical and horizontal around `breakpoint` (default `md`) by viewport width; `horizontal` and `vertical` fix the direction regardless of the viewport. When an item label is truncated, hovering or keyboard focus shows a tooltip with the full text, or a long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)); a long press that shows the tooltip does not select the item. `orientation`, `breakpoint`, `label-key`, `value-key` and `ui` can have site-wide defaults; see [Configurable props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults#configurable-props).

<component-example name="radio-group-orientation">



</component-example>

</component-example>

</component-example>

## Examples

### Item append content

When an item needs an input right next to its label (for example "○ Fixed amount <span>

hundreds

</span>

"), use the `#item-append` slot. The example selects "Fixed amount" when its amount input is focused:

<component-example name="radio-group-append">



</component-example>

- Clicking the appended content (the input, the unit or empty space) does not change the selection; to select on focus, bind `@focus="select"`.

### With form validation

Use `requiredText` for a required group (empty is `''`). To validate an appended input, wrap it in its own `UFormField` and show its error through the outer `error-pattern`. The example only requires the amount when "Fixed amount" is selected; otherwise the amount input is disabled.

<component-example name="radio-group-validation">



</component-example>

### Showing fields by selection

The mailing address only appears when "Mail" is selected; the schema switches by delivery method with `v.variant`, and the address is required for mail.

# SelectMenu

> Select menu with search and multiple selection, showing a full-text tooltip when the text is too long.

`v-model`: the item's value for single selection, an array of values when `multiple`; see [`empty-value`](#single-and-multiple) for the cleared value.

## Usage

### Single and multiple

Single selection binds the item's value; with `multiple`, it binds an array of values, and the selected labels are joined with ", ". An empty single selection is `empty-value` (default `''`, can be `null`), and an empty multiple selection is `[]`.

<component-example name="select-menu-basic">



</component-example>

### Display format

`format` defaults to `{label}`, showing only the label. `{value}` and `{label}` are replaced, the result is not parsed again, and unknown tokens are kept as is. The same format applies to the items and the selected text.

<component-example name="select-menu-format">



</component-example>

To show "value_label" across the whole project, set `format` site-wide:

<code-group>

```vue [Single component]
<ShuoSelectMenu v-model="state.type" :items="items" format="{value}_{label}" />
```

```ts [Site-wide]
// nuxt.config.ts
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  shuoUi: {
    components: {
      selectMenu: { format: '{value}_{label}' }
    }
  }
});
```

</code-group>

### Custom item fields

When the back-end fields are not `label` and `value`, set them with `label-key` and `value-key`. Props of `USelectMenu` such as `description-key` work directly too; field names are inferred from `items`, and a wrong name is a type error.

<component-example name="select-menu-keys">



</component-example>

### Search

The menu has a built-in search input with the placeholder "Search..." ("關鍵字查詢..." in Traditional Chinese), which can be changed in [Locales and messages](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages#overridable-items). The search matches the `label-key` field and is not affected by the display format. With only a few items, pass `:search-input="false"` to hide the search input.

<component-example name="select-menu-search">



</component-example>

### Variants

Uses the `variant`, `color` and `highlight` of `USelectMenu`.

<component-example name="select-menu-variant">



</component-example>

### Icon

Uses the `icon` and `trailing-icon` of `USelectMenu`; `icon` shows on the left, and `trailing-icon` replaces the arrow on the right.

<component-example name="select-menu-icon">



</component-example>

### Size and states

While loading, a spinner replaces the arrow on the right and the menu is disabled. Switching to skeleton, disabled or loading closes an open menu, and it does not reopen afterwards. See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the behavior shared by all states.

<component-example name="select-menu-states">



</component-example>

## Examples

### With form validation

An empty single selection is `''`, so use `requiredText`; an empty multiple selection is `[]`, so use `requiredArray`.

<component-example name="select-menu-validation">



</component-example>

### Truncated text tooltip

When the selected text is wider than the field, it is truncated with an ellipsis, and a tooltip shows the full text on hover or focus, or on long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)); a long press does not open the menu. The tooltip is not shown while the menu is open. Set the width on `ui.wrapper`; see [Styling](#styling) below.

<component-example name="select-menu-truncate">



</component-example>

### Loading items asynchronously

While fetching items from the back end, use `loading` to show a spinner and disable the menu, then fill in `items` when the request completes. When the bound value has no matching item, `placeholder` is shown, and the label appears automatically once the items arrive.

<component-example name="select-menu-async">



</component-example>

### Dependent menus

When the city changes, the district is cleared, and the district `items` are computed from the city.

<component-example name="select-menu-cascade">



</component-example>

### Opening the menu

Get the trigger button through `triggerRef` on the template ref and call `click()` to open the menu.

<component-example name="select-menu-expose">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoSelectMenu">



</component-props>

See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#shared-props) for the behavior of `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `skeleton`, `id` and `name`.

When `open` is not set, the user opens and closes the menu; there is no v-model for it. The types of `clear` and `clearIcon` are inferred from another Nuxt UI generic that this component does not provide, so they are not in its types.

# Switch

> A switch that can run an action after toggling, updating only on success and reverting on failure.

`v-model: boolean | string | number`, boolean by default. Apart from `action` and label truncation, its props, events and slots are the same as `USwitch`.

## Usage

### Label and description

`label` is the text next to the switch and `description` the text below it. It shows on one line and is truncated when wider than its container. A tooltip shows the full text on hover or focus, or on long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)), the same as the [checkbox](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/choice/checkbox#label). The description wraps: without one the height matches an input, and with one the switch grows while its first line still lines up with fields next to it.

<component-example name="switch-basic">



</component-example>

### Action

`action` runs after toggling, receives the new value and may return a Promise. Use it for settings that are saved through an API as soon as they change, such as enabling an account or notifications.

<component-example name="switch-action">



</component-example>

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      Stage
    </th>
    
    <th>
      Switch
    </th>
    
    <th>
      <code>
        v-model
      </code>
    </th>
    
    <th>
      <code>
        change
      </code>
      
       event
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      Pending
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Shows the new value, loading and disabled
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Unchanged
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Not emitted
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      Success
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Keeps the new value, loading and disabled end
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Updated to the new value
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Emitted
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      Failure
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Goes back to the old value, loading and disabled end
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Unchanged
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Not emitted
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      Error
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Same as failure
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Unchanged
    </td>
    
    <td>
      Not emitted
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

- **Success**: only returning `false` (or a Promise resolving to `false`) counts as a failure. Any other value is a success, including no return value as in `async () => { await save(value) }`.
- **Errors**: when the action throws, the switch reverts the same way and the error is thrown again, for the global error handler or the console. To notify the user, `try`/`catch` inside the action, show a message and return `false`, as in the example above.
- **Pending**: the switch is disabled, so the action is not called twice. If the page changes `v-model` while pending, the page's value wins and is not overwritten when the action finishes.
- **Without action**, `v-model` updates right after toggling, the same as `USwitch`.

The `SwitchAction` and `SwitchValue` types can be imported from `#shuo-ui/components/ShuoSwitch.vue`.

### On and off values

`true-value` and `false-value` are the bound values when on and off, `true` and `false` by default. Change them when the back end uses `Y`/`N`; the action receives these values too.

<component-example name="switch-values">



</component-example>

### Size and states

When `size` is not set, it follows the `UFormField` size and the site-wide setting, `lg` built in, the same as the other input components. Without a description, the switch height matches an input of the same size (24 to 40px for `xs` to `xl`), so it lines up with other fields in the same row. `loading` shows a loading icon and disables the switch; `disabled` follows the form state when not set; `skeleton` covers it with a skeleton of the same size. See [Common props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the shared behavior of the states.

<component-example name="switch-states">



</component-example>

`size`, `color` and `loadingIcon` can be set site-wide with `components.switch` in [Component defaults](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults).

## Examples

### Loading state on buttons

Buttons need no wrapper: with `loading-auto`, `UButton` shows loading and is disabled until the Promise returned by `@click` settles.

```vue
<UButton label="Save" loading-auto @click="save" />
```

# Datepicker

> Date picker with ROC years by default, five precisions and range selection.

`v-model: string` (`[string, string] | []` for ranges), plus `v-model:start` and `v-model:end`; see [v-model](#v-model) below. By default it shows ROC years and picks a full date; the bound value is always a Gregorian string.

## Usage

### Modes

`mode` sets the precision, `date` by default; the bound value is always a Gregorian string. The year and year-month displays below are the English ones (Traditional Chinese shows "115 年" and "115 年 09 月").

<table>
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th>
      mode
    </th>
    
    <th>
      ROC display
    </th>
    
    <th>
      Gregorian display
    </th>
    
    <th>
      v-model
    </th>
  </tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        year
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      115
    </td>
    
    <td>
      2026
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        "2026"
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        month
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      09/115
    </td>
    
    <td>
      09/2026
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        "2026/09"
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        date
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      115/09/20
    </td>
    
    <td>
      2026/09/20
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        "2026/09/20"
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        datetime
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      115/09/20 14:02
    </td>
    
    <td>
      2026/09/20 14:02
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        "2026/09/20 14:02"
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
  
  <tr>
    <td>
      <code>
        datetime-second
      </code>
    </td>
    
    <td>
      115/09/20 14:02:09
    </td>
    
    <td>
      2026/09/20 14:02:09
    </td>
    
    <td>
      <code>
        "2026/09/20 14:02:09"
      </code>
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<component-example name="datepicker-modes">



</component-example>

- When the year mode opens, the selected year scrolls to the middle of the list; with nothing selected, the current year is centered and the bound value stays `''`. Near either end of the year range, scrolling stops at the range.
- Date-times are local calendar times, with no UTC or time zone conversion.
- After switching `mode`, an existing value that does not match the new format is cleared; see the warning below. The example keeps a matching value for each `mode`.

### ROC years and separators

`roc` only switches the display, is on by default and does not rewrite the bound value; `separator` only affects the bound value, `/` by default, and the display still uses slashes.

<component-example name="datepicker-roc">



</component-example>

- The ROC year is the Gregorian year minus 1911; 1911 shows as ROC year 0. The year button and year list use the same rule.
- In ROC mode, dates before 1911 are neither shown nor selectable; Gregorian mode uses the normal year range.
- The bound value uses slashes by default; when your API uses hyphenated formats such as `YYYY-MM-DD`, set `separator="-"` to bind it directly. `separator` cannot be empty or contain digits, spaces or colons; an invalid one falls back to the default with a warning.

<warning>

When the parent passes a value (on mount or filled in later) that does not match the current `mode` and `separator`, has the wrong type, is before the ROC lower bound, or is a range whose start is after its end, the component clears the bound value and logs a `console.warn` with `[ShuoDatepicker] modelValue 格式不符，已清空：` or `起迄相反`. After switching `mode`, `roc` or `separator`, an existing value that does not match the new settings is also cleared with a warning, so fill in a matching value at the same time.

</warning>

Each clearing emits `update:modelValue` (or `update:start`, `update:end`) only once; for a reversed range, no temporary sorted value is emitted first.

### Range binding

`range` turns on range selection. The main array and the separate start and end stay in sync, to fit different APIs. Only a complete start-end array or `[]` is committed, never half a range.

<component-example name="datepicker-range">



</component-example>

- When both bindings are given on initialization, the main `v-model` wins; afterwards the parent can update either the main value or start and end.
- When cleared, the main value is `[]` and start and end are `''`. When the parent binds `null` or `undefined`, the component writes back `''` for a single date, `[]` for a range, and `''` for start and end.
- When only start and end are bound, they can be filled in separately; an invalid format on one side clears only that side, and when both have values but the start is after the end, both are cleared.
- When you do not need the main array, write just `<ShuoDatepicker v-model:start="start" v-model:end="end" range />`; see [Binding only start and end](#binding-only-start-and-end). The end date needs a start date; the component does not treat an end date alone as a complete range.

### Selectable dates

`min-date` and `max-date` limit the earliest and latest selectable dates, and dates outside cannot be selected; `year-range` is the Gregorian range of the year list, `[1900, 2100]` by default.

<component-example name="datepicker-limits">



</component-example>

- In ROC mode, `min-date` is at least 1911/01/01 and the lower bound of `year-range` is at least 1911.
- A string `min-date` can use slashes or hyphens and can include hours and minutes (and seconds).
- The year and year-month modes compare `min-date` by whole year and whole month.

### Icons and clear button

`clearable` shows a clear button, off by default; after clearing, the bound value is `''` (`[]` for ranges). `calendar-icon` is the trailing calendar icon, `i-lucide-calendar` by default; `clear-icon` is the clear button icon, `i-lucide-x` by default.

<component-example name="datepicker-icons">



</component-example>

### Validation state

`ShuoDatepicker` has no `color`; it uses `state` for the validation result: `false` shows an error, `true` shows success, and unset uses the normal style. Inside a `UFormField` with an error, it always shows the error.

<component-example name="datepicker-feedback">



</component-example>

### Size and states

While loading, a spinner replaces the trailing calendar icon and input is disabled. See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the behavior shared by all states.

<component-example name="datepicker-states">



</component-example>

## Examples

### With form validation

Use `requiredText` for a single date and `requiredArray` for a range. A range with only a start date is not committed and does not fire change, so the required error still shows. Inside a `UFormField`, it picks up the field's id, name, size, disabled and error state; see [With UForm and UFormField](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#with-uform-and-uformfield).

<component-example name="datepicker-validation">



</component-example>

### Binding only start and end

When the query API has separate start and end fields, bind only `v-model:start` and `v-model:end`, and use `separator="-"` for the `YYYY-MM-DD` format directly.

<component-example name="datepicker-start-end">



</component-example>

### Start and end limiting each other

When two single date pickers enter the start and end dates, use each other's value as `max-date` and `min-date` so the start cannot be after the end.

<component-example name="datepicker-linked-range">



</component-example>

## Interaction

### Selection flow

- **Year, year-month, date**: selecting applies the value and closes the menu, with no confirm / cancel buttons.
- **Range**: after selecting only the start date, a draft is kept and the parent's three bindings keep their values; the range is committed and the menu closed only after both dates are selected. Clicking outside, pressing Esc or closing the menu midway discards the draft and restores the last complete range; an empty value stays `[]`.
- **Date with hours and minutes / seconds**: after selecting a date, the full date-time is filled in immediately and the time panel opens. The time keeps the existing value, or the local current time set when the picker initialized if empty. Adjusting the time updates immediately; click outside to close and keep it.
- **Date-time range**: select both dates first, then switch to the start and end time panels; both times can be changed live.
- Switching from single to range clears the value and waits for a complete selection; turning range off keeps the start date as the single value and clears `start` and `end`.

### Keyboard

When the menu opens, focus moves to the selected date (or year, month), or to the first selectable item when nothing is selected. Arrow keys move focus, Enter selects and Esc closes; when the menu closes with focus still inside it, focus returns to the input. The menu is teleported to the body, so Tab cannot reach it.

### Calendar display

The calendar starts weeks on Sunday and always shows six weeks; dates from the previous and next months are dimmed. Changing months uses an opacity transition to avoid a scrollbar from horizontal movement.

Month and weekday names, the "年" in the year list, the year and year-month format ("115 年 10 月" in Traditional Chinese, "10/115" in English) and the range separator ("～" in Traditional Chinese, "–" in English) all switch with the locale; ROC or Gregorian years are still decided by `roc`. See [Locales and messages](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages).

## Props

<component-props :exclude="["start", "end"]" name="ShuoDatepicker">



</component-props>

See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common#shared-props) for the behavior of `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `skeleton`, `id` and `name`. `clearable`, `calendarIcon`, `clearIcon`, `roc`, `separator` and `yearRange` can have site-wide defaults; see [Configurable props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults#configurable-props).

<note>

The component only exposes the props in the table above and does not inherit every prop of `@vuepic/vue-datepicker`; `auto-apply`, `flow`, `config`, `formats`, `model-type` and others are managed inside the component.

</note>

## Styling

There is no `ui` prop. HTML attributes such as `class` and `style` go on the outer container and are not passed through to the date library. The container has a built-in `relative block w-full min-w-0`; `class` is merged with it using tailwind-merge and wins on conflicts, so it can override the width and minimum width (for example `class="w-40"` or `class="min-w-20"`).

When the displayed date is wider than the field, it is truncated with an ellipsis, and a tooltip shows the full text on hover or focus, or on long press on touch devices (see [Tooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press)); a long press does not open the calendar. The tooltip is not shown while the menu is open or during the skeleton.

- [@vuepic/vue-datepicker](https://vue3datepicker.com)


# Months

> Years and months input converted to total months, with total months, years and months all bindable.

`v-model: number | null` (total months), plus `v-model:year` and `v-model:month`; see [v-model](#v-model) below. It shows "years input yr months input mo".

## Usage

### Converting years and months

`v-model` is the total number of months, and `v-model:year` and `v-model:month` are the split years and months (0–11); the three bindings stay in sync.

<component-example name="months-basic">



</component-example>

- Only non-negative integers are accepted. The value carries over only after focus leaves the whole group (moving focus between years and months does not commit, so both can be cleared together): 0 years 13 months becomes 1 year 1 month, 13 months in total.
- The three bindings can be used alone or together. When the parent fills in total months and years/months that conflict, total months win; when only years/months are filled in, they are summed again and carried over.
- An empty side counts as 0; when both are empty, all three bindings are `null`. Strings, negative numbers, decimals, `NaN` or values beyond the safe integer range from the parent count as empty.

### Narrow containers

When the container is too narrow for both the years and months inputs, it switches to a single "total months" input; with enough width it goes back to both inputs, keeping any input not yet committed.

<component-example name="months-compact">



</component-example>

### Variants

Uses the `color` and `highlight` of `UInput`, applied to every input.

<component-example name="months-color">



</component-example>

### Size and states

While loading, a spinner shows after the months unit and input is disabled. The year and month units switch with the locale ("yr" and "mo" in English, "年" and "月" in Traditional Chinese); their width follows the text, and so does the width needed for the full years and months layout. See [Shared props](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/overview/common) for the behavior shared by all states.

<component-example name="months-states">



</component-example>

## Examples

### With form validation

Bind the total months, use `requiredNumber` for a required field, and check bounds separately with `v.minValue` and `v.maxValue`.

<component-example name="months-validation">



</component-example>

### Binding only years and months

When the API splits seniority into year and month fields, bind only `v-model:year` and `v-model:month`.

<component-example name="months-year-month">



</component-example>

# InfoTooltip

> Info icon with a tooltip, shown on hover, keyboard focus or long press on touch devices.

The tooltip shows on hover or keyboard focus with no delay; on touch devices it shows on a long press of the icon, not on tap. The tooltip is provided by [ShuoTooltip](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip); see [Touch long press](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/helper/tooltip#touch-long-press) for the touch behavior.

## Usage

### Tooltip text

`text` is the tooltip content. It supports line breaks, and long text wraps within the maximum width. When `text` is empty and there is no `#content` slot, no tooltip is shown.

<component-example name="info-tooltip-text">



</component-example>

For formatting such as bold text, use the `#content` slot; see [Custom content](#custom-content).

### Icon and color

`icon` is the trigger button's icon, `i-lucide-circle-alert` by default. `class` goes on the trigger button; for example, `class="text-warning"` changes the icon color.

<component-example name="info-tooltip-icon">



</component-example>

The icon button has no visible text, so provide an accessible name with `label`.

## Examples

### Field hint

Put it in the `#hint` of `UFormField` to show the icon to the right of the field label.

<component-example name="info-tooltip-form-field">



</component-example>

### Custom content

Use the `#content` slot for formatting such as bold text and colors.

<component-example name="info-tooltip-content">



</component-example>

### Tooltip width

The tooltip's maximum width is `max-w-xs` by default and can be adjusted with `ui.tooltip.content`, for example `:ui="{ tooltip: { content: 'max-w-md' } }"`.

<component-example name="info-tooltip-width">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoInfoTooltip">



</component-props>

The default of `label` can be overridden with the `infoTooltip.label` text.

# Tooltip

> Tooltip built on UTooltip that adds long press on touch devices.

Nuxt UI's `UTooltip` only shows on hover or keyboard focus, so on phones neither tapping nor holding shows it. `ShuoTooltip` keeps every prop and slot of `UTooltip` and only adds long press on touch devices; just change `UTooltip` to `ShuoTooltip`.

Every tooltip in the library uses it: `ShuoInfoTooltip` and the truncated-text tooltips of the select menu, date picker, file input, checkbox and option groups all show on long press on phones too.

## Usage

### Tooltip text

`text` is the tooltip content, and the trigger goes in the default slot. Props such as `kbds`, `content`, `arrow` and `delayDuration` are the same as Nuxt UI.

<component-example name="tooltip-text">



</component-example>

### Touch long press

On touch devices, holding the trigger for about 0.5 seconds shows the tooltip, which stays open after you lift your finger and closes when you tap elsewhere or scroll the page.

- When a long press shows the tooltip, lifting your finger does not trigger the trigger's own action (click, check, open a menu and so on).
- A normal tap triggers the original action as usual without showing the tooltip; focus caused by a tap does not show it either.
- Moving your finger after pressing counts as scrolling and does not show the tooltip.
- During a long press, the browser's long-press menu is not shown and text inside the trigger is not selected (except in inputs).

With `touch` set to `false`, it behaves like the original Nuxt UI tooltip and touch cannot open it.

<component-example name="tooltip-touch">



</component-example>

To turn it off site-wide, set `components.tooltip.touch: false`; the tooltips inside the library turn off too. See [Component defaults](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/component-defaults).

### Open state

Bind the open state with `v-model:open` to open or close it from code; without binding, set the initial state with `default-open`.

<component-example name="tooltip-open">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoTooltip">



</component-props>

    </td>

    </td>

# ListCard

> Result list card with a title bar, a table and server-side pagination.

A list card for query results: a title bar, a [ShuoTable](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/table) data area and pagination, with pagination handled by the back end. The generic `T` is the row type. The skeleton, empty data, loading text and height transition are handled by `ShuoTable`; when you do not need the card and pagination, use `ShuoTable` directly.

## Usage

### Server-side pagination

Pagination is handled by the back end: the component emits `page-change`, and the page updates `page` and `data` after the query for that page succeeds. It is not emitted while loading, or when the page is the current one or out of range. `interactionDisabled` is `true` while loading and can be used to disable actions in the list.

<component-example name="list-card-basic">



</component-example>

The `PageRequest` type can be imported from `#shuo-ui/types/pagination`; see [Auto-imports and types](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/advanced/auto-imports#types). For the full pattern with query fields, see [With ListCard](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/query-card#with-listcard) on ShuoQueryCard.

### Title and icon

`title` is the title text and `icon` is the icon to the left of the title; pass an empty string to hide the icon. The title bar wraps by the same rules as `ShuoQueryCard`; see [Long titles](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/query-card#long-titles).

<component-example name="list-card-title">



</component-example>

### Pagination and counts

`show-pagination` controls the pagination at the bottom left, shown even with a single page; `show-summary` controls the count and range at the bottom right; `page-size` is the number of rows per page, 10 by default.

<component-example name="list-card-footer">



</component-example>

- After changing `page-size`, query again from the first page with `getPagination(1)`; see [Re-querying the current page](#re-querying-the-current-page).
- When both pagination and the summary are off, the bottom only shows `#footer`; without `#footer`, there is no bottom area.

### Loading and empty data

When the component is created while loading with no data, skeleton rows are shown; when re-querying with existing data, the data fades and switches with a height transition. `empty` is the empty-data text, using the table default when not set; with `transition` set to `false`, no transition plays. The behavior is the same as [ShuoTable](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/table#loading-and-empty-data).

<component-example name="list-card-states">



</component-example>

The title "Results" and the bottom summary switch with the locale ("Results" and "Showing 1 to 10 of 25 results." in English, "查詢結果" and its summary in Traditional Chinese), and can be overridden globally with the `listCard.title` and `listCard.summary` texts; "Loading…" and "No data" belong to the `table` group. See [Locales and messages](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/getting-started/theme/messages).

### Selection

`selectable`, `select-all`, `selection-header`, `row-key`, `row-selectable`, `checkbox-props` and `v-model:selected` are passed to the table; see [Selection in ShuoTable](https://k90325248.github.io/shuo-ui/components/layout/table#selection). Set `row-key` with server-side pagination: selections on other pages are kept when changing pages, so rows selected across pages can be handled together.

<component-example name="list-card-selection">



</component-example>

## Examples

### Title bar actions and footer content

`#title` replaces the title text, `#header-right` holds actions on the right of the title bar, and `#footer` follows the pagination and summary. `#header-right` and `#footer` receive `interactionDisabled` to disable actions while loading.

<component-example name="list-card-header-right">



</component-example>

### Re-querying the current page

`getPagination()` on the template ref returns the current page number and the component's page size; passing a page number (such as `getPagination(1)`) returns that page instead, suited to the first query or going back to page one after the filters change.

<component-example name="list-card-expose">



</component-example>

## Props

<component-props name="ShuoListCard">



</component-props>
